description: Google Drive is Google’s cloud file storage and synchronization service for storing, sharing, and organizing files. It also provides developer access to Drive data and operations through Google Workspace APIs and an MCP server.
summary: Google Drive exposes a REST API at `https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/` and a remote MCP server at `https://drivemcp.googleapis.com/mcp/v1`; both use Google-issued authentication, with the REST API accepting OAuth/service-account bearer tokens and some requests also allowing an API key.
